adjudication.rationale: The duplication is real and it creates a concrete failure mode. In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `execute` guards `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?` before calling `poll_feed`, so `SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase` is safe there. But `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` (lib/topic_retriever.rb) does `User.where(username_lower: SiteSetting.embed_by_username.downcase).first` with no presence check; if `embed_by_username` is nil/blank, calling `downcase` will raise (e.g., `NoMethodError`). This can be triggered via `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` -> `TopicRetriever#retrieve` -> `perform_retrieve` -> `fetch_http` when embedding is used but `embed_by_username` is not configured.
